subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Clearpath Biopharma — ownership & onboarding
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Clearpath Biopharma — proposed timeline & roles

Hi Sara / Vince — congrats again on the signing, really excited to get going. Attaching the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP) and the SOW draft so CS and your team have a single source of truth.

High-level proposal (happy to adjust):
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks (pilot + acceptance tests), target kickoff: 2027-05-25
- Production readiness target: 2027-07-01 (depends on SSO and data access)
- Success criteria: latency < 200ms p95 for key routes, embedding recall >= 92% on validation set, and completion of the integration checklist below

Immediate asks for Clearpath:
- Confirm internal stakeholders + SMEs (IT, Data Ops, Security)
- Share calendar availability for a 60-min MAP kickoff next week
- Upload any red-team / compliance contacts we should loop in for the SOC2 questionnaire

Tessa (cc) will take point for onboarding and delivery; Marissa (cc) will own technical handoff and eval configuration. I will remain engaged through procurement milestone closing.

Attachments: [Mutual_Action_Plan_Clearpath_v1.xlsx] [SOW_draft_20270518.pdf]

Next steps: if you can confirm stakeholders and a couple of time windows by EOD Friday, I’ll lock the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to this one.

—
Aditya Rao

- Evaluation window: can we expand to 6 weeks instead of 4? Our QA schedule is tight in early June.
- Stakeholders: Vince Luo (IT lead, infra), Lila Chen (Data Ops/ETL), and I’m copying procurement for DocuSign specifics. Procurement expects to complete signatures by 2027-05-27.
- Compliance: our security team requests the SOC2 questionnaire and network diagram (if you have a redacted one).

Proposed kickoff windows: 2027-05-25 10–11am PT or 2027-05-26 9–10am PT. Either works for us but we prefer the 26th if possible.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Myers <sara@clearpathbio.com>, Vince Luo <vince@clearpathbio.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction & MAP kickoff — CS ownership and onboarding plan (Clearpath)

Hi Sara / Vince — pleased to meet you both, I’m Tessa and I’ll be your Customer Success Manager at Redwood. Thanks Aditya for the intro. I’ll summarize ownership and the first 30/60/90 plan so everyone has clarity: 

30 days (pilot kickoff & baseline)
- MAP kickoff meeting (60m): align tech owners, confirm evaluation dataset, and finalize acceptance tests
- Marissa (Solutions Engineer) will run integration workshop and help instrument telemetry for the eval
- Deliverable: pilot workspace + test harness accessible to Clearpath (we’ll need a service account + IP allowlist or SSO)

60 days (pilot execution & adjust)
- Weekly syncs (30m) between CS, SE, and Clearpath to iterate on prompt templates, eval metrics, and batching/quantization settings
- Security/QA checkpoints: provide redacted network diagram and completed SOC2 questionnaire fields requested by your security team

90 days (acceptance & rollout prep)
- Acceptance review and production cutover checklist; handover to Dedicated environment (if selected)

Roles & contacts (Redwood):
- Customer Success: Tessa Morgan (CS lead) — owner of adoption, MAP milestones, and success criteria
- Solutions Engineering: Marissa Cole — technical integration, eval harness, runbooks
- Sales: Aditya Rao — procurement and commercial follow-up

Action items for this week:
1) Sara/Vince: confirm preferred kickoff slot (you mentioned 5/26 09:00 PT — that works for us).
2) Please upload the vendor intake and security contact — I can coordinate a short walkthrough with our security ops.
3) Aditya: please confirm the committed credits and any promotional terms so I can log them in the MAP (deal ID RWF-2027-0487).

I’ve added the MAP draft to a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearpath-map (view-only for now). I’ll prepare an agenda and invite once Sara confirms the kickoff time.

Attachments referenced: [Mutual_Action_Plan_Clearpath_v1.xlsx] — will upload a cleaned copy after the kickoff.

Looking forward to working together. If it helps, I can prepare a short onboarding checklist for your IT team ahead of the call.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com | (408) 555-0224
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Tessa / Marissa — quick internal note after Sara’s confirmation:
- Kickoff locked for 2027-05-26 09:00 PT.
- Procurement expects signatures by 2027-05-27; they asked DocuSign be routed to procure@clearpathbio.com and Sara.
- Committed credits: 150k tokens/month for first 3 months (apply promotional credit PR-2027-119). Please log in the MAP and track usage against the pilot SLA.
- Security ask: Clearpath wants the SOC2 questionnaire fields and a redacted network diagram before 2027-05-24. Can SE / Security pack prepare the standard redacted diagram and the questionnaire response template?

Happy to jump on a short prep call if you want to review the kickoff agenda before the meeting.

—Aditya
